children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - Emerita Resources Corp.

(OTCQX: EMOTF) (FSE: LLJA) (the "Company" or "Emerita") announces that it has posted a presentation on its website providing additional information on the Pre-Feasibility Study ("PFS") for its wholly-owned Iberian Belt West Project ("IBW") in Spain.

The presentation provides an overview of the PFS results announced on October 29, 2026, including the technical and financial considerations of IBW, and addresses certain questions raised by shareholders following the release of the PFS.

"We appreciate our shareholders' patience while we prepared the presentation. It provides a more detailed overview of the technical and financial aspects of IBW and addresses many of the questions we have received following the release of the PFS results. We will continue to provide shareholders with updates as work on IBW progresses," commented Joaquin Merino, President and Chief Executive Officer of Emerita.
The presentation is available on the Company's website at

Emerita is a natural resource company engaged in the acquisition, exploration and development of mineral properties in Europe, with a primary focus on exploring in Spain. The Company's corporate office and technical team are based in Sevilla, Spain, with an administrative office in Toronto, Canada.
